Description of change: New scalable form merging FM1-QM.SLQ004 and TMP1-QM.SLQ005. Includes mandatory V&V planning determination field with QA approval (closes mNC 1 sub-issue 7) and mandatory plan-revision change-control log (closes mNC 1 sub-issue 3). Reason for change: IA-2025 mNC 1 sub-issues 2, 3, and 7; operationalizes QM.SLQ052 Rev A.

Description of change: New mandatory change assessment record for Pathways B and C. Captures change source, hold decision (Pathway C), design impact, risk determination, V&V determination, regulatory assessment (Letter-to-File or 510(k) retained in DHF), and routing to the DCO process. Reason for change: IA-2025 mNC 1 sub-issues 1, 6, 7, 8, 9; FDA 483 Observation 2 and CAPA 2025-003 supplier change trigger; IA-2025 mNC 3.

Description of change: New scalable design review form with gate selector (Gate 1, 2, 3, and Fast-Track) replacing FM1-QM.SLQ008. Includes required attendee list, gate-specific deliverable checklist, action items, conclusion, and DHF closure block. Reason for change: IA-2025 mNC 1 sub-issues 2, 5, and 9; operationalizes QM.SLQ052 Rev A Section 12.

Description of change: New consolidated Design Control SOP replacing QM.SLQ004 through QM.SLQ010. Defines Pathway A (three-gate full development), Pathway B (design change), and Pathway C (supplier or CMO-initiated change with mandatory trigger and hold decision). Includes conflict resolution authority, V&V planning and validation equivalence requirements, formal design output control, risk management integration, final design review requirement at transfer, DHF lifecycle in SILQ eQMS, and Medical Device File framework per ISO 13485 clause 4.2.3. Reason for change: IA-2025 mNC 1 (all nine sub-issues); CAPA 004-2025 Action 5 (closes on DCO095 effective date); FDA 483 Observation 2 and CAPA 2025-003 design-control corrective; 2026 Quality Plan; DC.SLQ002 Phase 1B and Phase 2 FileHold-reference elimination.
